## Quality checklist

- [ ] Avoided invented benefits, generic affiliate marketing and unsupported promises.
- [ ] Linked official terms, not just a deal aggregator.
- [ ] Identified geography, expiry, credit/discount limits and auto-billing where relevant.
- [ ] Updated local README/index navigation and structured catalog where required.
- [ ] Included practical steps and a pass/fail or completion result.
- [ ] Used no private data, credentials, referral codes or identifiable test recordings.
- [ ] Checked local links and reviewed documentation for mobile readability.
- [ ] Stated what remains unknown and requires a future recheck.
